package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"go/token"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

type fileRecord struct {
	Path   string `json:"path"`
	Source string `json:"source"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
}

type manifest struct {
	Version    int          `json:"version"`
	Package    string       `json:"package"`
	PackageDir string       `json:"package_dir"`
	Test       string       `json:"test"`
	Race       bool         `json:"race"`
	Files      []fileRecord `json:"files"`
}

func relative(p string, allowDot bool) bool {
	if p == "." {
		return allowDot
	}
	return p != "" && !strings.ContainsAny(p, "\\:\x00") &&
		!filepath.IsAbs(p) && filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(p)) == p &&
		p != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(p, "../")
}

// The roots may be explicitly selected through symlinks, but paths INSIDE
// the bundle/clone must not traverse symlinks, even links currently pointing
// back inside. There is no claim of protection against hostile filesystem races.
func contained(root, rel string, mayBeMissing bool) (string, error) {
	if !relative(rel, true) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsafe relative path %q", rel)
	}
	path := root
	parts := strings.Split(rel, "/")
	for i, part := range parts {
		path = filepath.Join(path, part)
		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
		if os.IsNotExist(err) && mayBeMissing && i == len(parts)-1 {
			return path, nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("symlink in path: %s", path)
		}
		if i < len(parts)-1 && !info.IsDir() {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("not a directory: %s", path)
		}
	}
	return path, nil
}

func prepare(bundle, module, output string) error {
	var err error
	bundle, err = filepath.EvalSymlinks(bundle)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	bundle, err = filepath.Abs(bundle)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	module, err = filepath.EvalSymlinks(module)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	module, err = filepath.Abs(module)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	manifestPath, err := contained(bundle, "bundle.json", false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	raw, err := os.Open(manifestPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer raw.Close()
	var m manifest
	dec := json.NewDecoder(raw)
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(&m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := dec.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
		return fmt.Errorf("trailing or malformed manifest data")
	}
	if m.Version != 1 || m.Package == "" || !relative(m.PackageDir, true) ||
		!token.IsIdentifier(m.Test) || !strings.HasPrefix(m.Test, "TestGo2LeanPoC_") ||
		m.Test == "TestGo2LeanPoC_" || len(m.Files) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported/incomplete bundle manifest")
	}
	pkgDir, err := contained(module, m.PackageDir, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info, err := os.Stat(pkgDir); err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
		return fmt.Errorf("missing target package directory")
	}
	replacements := map[string]string{}
	harness := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.PackageDir, "zz_go2lean_poc_"+strings.TrimPrefix(m.Test, "TestGo2LeanPoC_")+"_test.go"))
	hasHarness := false
	for _, f := range m.Files {
		if !relative(f.Path, false) || !relative(f.Source, false) ||
			filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(f.Path)) != m.PackageDir ||
			!strings.HasSuffix(f.Path, ".go") || !strings.HasSuffix(f.Source, ".go") {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid package-local Go source mapping: %q", f.Path)
		}
		dest, err := contained(module, f.Path, true)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if info, err := os.Lstat(dest); err == nil && !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return fmt.Errorf("destination is not a regular file: %s", dest)
		}
		if _, exists := replacements[dest]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate destination: %s", dest)
		}
		source, err := contained(bundle, f.Source, false)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if info, err := os.Stat(source); err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %s", source)
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(source)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if f.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)) {
			return fmt.Errorf("source SHA-256 mismatch: %s", f.Source)
		}
		replacements[dest] = source
		if f.Path == harness {
			hasHarness = true
		}
	}
	if !hasHarness {
		return fmt.Errorf("manifest does not include the observation test harness")
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(struct{ Replace map[string]string }{replacements}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// All validation finishes before creating output. Never overwrite a file.
	out, err := os.OpenFile(output, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := out.Write(append(data, '\n')); err != nil {
		out.Close()
		os.Remove(output)
		return err
	}
	return out.Close()
}

func main() {
	bundle := flag.String("bundle", ".", "directory holding bundle.json and its source files")
	module := flag.String("module", "", "disposable target clone/module directory")
	output := flag.String("output", "", "NEW overlay JSON file to create")
	flag.Parse()
	if *module == "" || *output == "" || flag.NArg() != 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: go run prepare.go -bundle <bundle> -module <scratch-clone> -output <new-overlay.json>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	if err := prepare(*bundle, *module, *output); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "prepare overlay:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("Overlay prepared. Target code was not built or executed; only the requested JSON output was created.")
}
